requirements.requirement: Repair the symlinks under bundle/ so they remain symlinks, use relative paths, match the intended targets in links.tsv, and resolve correctly in the current location.
requirements.summary: Both originally broken absolute links were replaced with the exact relative targets recorded in links.tsv. Direct checks confirm they remain symlinks, resolve successfully, and read the intended report.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the bundle continues to work when copied to another directory.
requirements.summary: Two bounded relocation tests, including one after restart, copied the bundle to temporary directories and directly verified both link types, relative targets, resolution, and content.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the regular files and their contents.
requirements.summary: The two regular files in bundle/ retained the same SHA-256 hashes as the preparation baseline before repair, after repair, after relocation, and after restart. The command timeline contains no mutation of links.tsv.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on Alpine Linux v3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts before and after execution and restart. No package installation or platform replacement occurred; the repair used available platform utilities.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct evidence. The mandatory node1 restart protocol is also complete: it records a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement and bounded unavailability, a different post-restart boot identity, recovered services and bundle data, and matching lifecycle boot-identity observations. The only observed defect is a small retained reboot log in /tmp.
limitations: The generic failed-services lifecycle probe is unsupported on this OpenRC platform, although pre- and post-restart rc-status output directly shows the relevant services started.
No final hash was captured for links.tsv itself; preservation is supported by the complete command timeline showing no write to it and by successful post-restart parsing of its expected entries.

Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: The desired symlink replacement was narrowly scoped. Relocation-test directories were temporary and removed by traps, and the restart was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol. The sole hygiene defect is /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log, created by the restart command and left behind after execution. No unnecessary troubleshooting mutation is evidenced; the failed BusyBox find attempt and restart availability polling were read-only. Package-health output was unchanged from the preparation baseline, and listening-socket differences are consistent with the observed restart.
